text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS)

The ABG results confirm respiratory acidosis and hypoxemia consistent with prematurity, not tuberculosis. Given the 33-week gestation and onset of distress within two hours of birth, RDS is the most likely diagnosis. I will proceed to order a Chest X-Ray to confirm the presence of ground-glass opacities typical of surfactant deficiency.
